capt_pfd.purpose:
A/P RST (Autopilot Reset)

Illuminates when the autopilot has disengaged due to a fault or needs to be reset.
Indicates the system dropped offline—not a normal manual disconnect.

A/T RST (Autothrottle Reset)

Comes on when the autothrottle system disengages due to a fault condition.
Signals the need for reset or maintenance attention.

FMC (or FMC PRI / FMC alert)

Indicates a Flight Management Computer–related issue affecting autoflight or guidance.
Often tied to loss of FMC input to the autoflight system.

TEST Switch (right side)

Position 1: Checks amber indications
Position 2: Checks red indications
Confirms bulbs and circuits are working correctly (like your earlier procedure)

Big picture
These lights are fault-status indicators, not normal operation lights.
They help crew and maintenance quickly identify which autoflight component dropped out or failed:

A/P → autopilot issue
A/T → autothrottle issue
FMC → guidance/computer issue

AMM Task 22-11-32-000-801

causes: FCC Airspeed Warning Problem - Fault Isolation

capt_pfd.bite:
Press and hold TEST switch to position 1 → verify A/T P/RST light amber (steady).
Release to center → verify light off.
Press and hold TEST switch to position 2 → verify A/T P/RST light red (steady).
Release to center → verify light off.


If light fails any check: Replace A/T P/RST warning light and perform repair confirmation.
If light operates correctly: Continue with procedure.

capt_pfd.full:
DO THE LRU Replacement Test
FIM Task 22-11-00-810-802

DFCS BITE Test (CDU) – Simplified Procedure
Access DFCS BITE

Press INIT REF
Select INDEX (if POS INIT page shows)
Select:

MAINT
DFCS

If messages appear (FCC-A FAIL / FCC-B FAIL / CROSS CHANNEL FAIL) → go to FIM task.

LRU Replacement Test Setup

Select LRU REPLACEMENT TEST
Select channel:

A, B, or A/B

Select desired LRU test (use NEXT/PREV if needed)


Autotest

Follow CDU prompts → “AUTOTEST IN PROGRESS”
PASS: No faults (may clear too fast to see)
FAIL: Run required library tests
Record: channel, suspect LRU, pin data
Optional: TEST DATA → RERUN

Interactive Test

Follow CDU prompts
PASS: “ALL TESTS PASSED”
FAIL:

Check TEST RESULTS
Record channel, LRU, pins
Optional rerun

Surface Test (⚠️ Hydraulic hazard)

Keep clear of all flight controls
Run per CDU instructions
PASS: No faults
FAIL:

Check TEST RESULTS
Record channel, LRU, pins
Optional rerun

After Any Failure

Each suspect LRU = maintenance message
Use FIM table to find fault isolation task
